text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is delicious, Trainer! I could
eat it
nonstop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a way to show their thanks for
Copano Rickey
having saved their inn,
the couple we recently
met have invited
us to enjoy their campsite.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're nice and full, it's time to
revitalize
our spirit by absorbing all we
can of nature's qi!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're so agile! I can see their
silhouettes
in the water, but none of
them are biting—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh, oh?! It's taken the bait! Are you my
lucky
catch? Grab the net, Trainer! The
net!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer! We can see Mount Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Did you know there are dragon veins
running
through Mount Fuji? The
connect all the way to
Tokyo,
channeling positive energy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just looking at it makes me want to
climb to
the summit! What do you say,
Trainer? Up for a
hike?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'm kidding! We should definitely
go
sometime though!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was a lot of fun! I guess it's
time to
head back.

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest A
text_block_list.text: Wait, so I'm the bad guy here?!

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You've been sulking this whole
time. You
sucked all the fun out of
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Startled by the sudden shouts of anger, I
turn to
see two campsite guests arguing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Oh that's not good at all. There's bad
energy
flowing all through the cottage
they're in. There's
a clashing of qi at
T-junction of the building.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might be able to do something to
rectify the
awkward atmosphere like she
did at the inn
before.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、風水で変えられるかも？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You bet I can! All riiight. Let's do it
Copa-style
once more! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... it's not good to argue!
Instead, how
about changing the mood
of your room with a
little feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?! Who do you think you are?
Did your
parents never teach you to
mind your own
business?

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Keep your nose out of it!
This is
between us two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The guests are right. What Copano
Rickey is
doing is, after all, meddling.
However...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to soothe your hearts with feng
shui! If you
give me a shot, I'll do the
best I can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She just wants to see them smile. She
wants
everyone here to enjoy
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? First her, now you? Who the heck
are you
people?
choice_data_list: 少し、この子の話を聞いてくれませんか？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 嫌な思い出を作ってほしくないだけなんです

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! We want to help you
enjoy your
camping trip!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You see, there are some building
structures that
make it easier for discord
to arise. If you look
over this way...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for helping out today,
Trainer! I'm glad
those two finally cooled
their heads!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you! I'm really happy
you
believed in me!
choice_data_list: 今日もお手柄だったな
今日もお手柄だったね

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You gave me a huge confidence boost!
And you
were so cool! Like, for real!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm grateful for your trust! You can
always
rely on this feng shui master!
choice_data_list: どうにかしてくれると思ったから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Copano Rickey full of
confidence, I realize
she's at her best
when she's in high spirits. The
event ends
up making for a great memory.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Hehe, actually, I was too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But, you did your very best to help me!
It was
thanks to you we got it all sorted
out!
Everything's totally Copa-cool!
Right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Part of her charm is how quickly she
seems to
perk up her mood. As this
thought comes to mind,
our conversation
turns to fond memories.
